reader.zh-Hant: ReadonlySubAgentTool 會在工具呼叫中啟動子 runtime，僅允許白名單工具，並強制禁止遞迴呼叫 `readonly_subagent`。
reader.en: ReadonlySubAgentTool spawns a child runtime inside a tool call, enforces tool whitelisting, and blocks recursive `readonly_subagent` calls.
reader.ja: ReadonlySubAgentTool はツール呼び出し内で子 runtime を起動し、ホワイトリスト制御と `readonly_subagent` 再帰禁止を適用します。

symbols.name: ReadonlySubAgentTool
symbols.summary: Launch readonly child runtime with restricted tools and return structured JSON result.

init.signature: ReadonlySubAgentTool(*, project_root: str, storage_directory: str = 'chat_history', provider: str = 'gemini', model: Optional[str] = None, api_key: Optional[str] = None, lm_api_url: Optional[str] = None, request_options: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, default_allowed_tools: Optional[List[str]] = None, tool_factories: Optional[Dict[str, Callable[[], BaseTool]]] = None, prompt_name: str = 'system_core')

params.name: project_root
params.description: Resolved project root for prompts and paths.

params.name: storage_directory
params.description: Parent dir; subagent histories go under storage_directory/subagents/.

params.name: model
params.description: Optional; Gemini defaults from GEMINI_MODEL env when None.

params.name: default_allowed_tools
params.description: Whitelist when allowed_tools argument is omitted on execute.

params.name: tool_factories
params.description: name -> factory for BaseTool instances registered on child executor.

tool_contract.name: readonly_subagent
tool_contract.description: Spawn a readonly sub-agent for heavy reading and reasoning tasks.

methods.name: execute
methods.signature: execute(task: str, max_steps: int = 8, allowed_tools: Optional[List[str]] = None, **kwargs: Any) -> str
methods.summary: Runs child agent task and returns JSON string with subagent_conversation_id, allowed_tools, and result.
behavior: max_steps is clamped to [1, 24] via max(1, min(max_steps, 24)).
Non-Gemini providers require model to be set on the tool instance.
If allowed_tools is None, default_allowed_tools is used; readonly_subagent is always stripped from the effective list.

methods.name: _resolve_allowed_tools
methods.summary: Computes deterministic effective whitelist while always blocking readonly_subagent recursion.

examples.title: Spawn sub-agent with factory map (integration pattern)
code_lines: # Typical wiring is done in create_agent_components(); pseudo-code:
print(tool.execute(task='Summarize repo README in 5 bullets', max_steps=6))

runtime_notes.content: readonly_subagent is always blocked from child toolset even if requested.
Child executor prepends </subagent> <subagent> warning text for web_search results to reduce prompt-injection risk.
